rules.name: Atomic Stock Deduction
rules.description: Stock deduction must be executed inside a database transaction alongside sale creation.
rules.recommendation: Wrap sale creation and inventory decrement inside a database transaction.

rules.name: Thermal Printer Fallback
rules.description: Receipt printing must support both 58mm/80mm ESC/POS and PDF sharing fallback.
rules.recommendation: Check printer connectivity and fallback to PDF generation when disconnected.

rules.name: Invoice Verification QR
rules.description: Printed receipts must embed a valid digital verification QR code.
rules.recommendation: Render verification QR code holding invoice number, timestamp, and signature hash.
